text:
Anya: heads-up — starting a mini-sprint to tidy docs voice + naming in SDK examples. Main goals: standardize 'route' vs 'endpoint', align 'model' vs 'model variant', fix broken links in embeddings guide, and migrate JS snippets to idiomatic patterns. I made a tracking PR list; looking for owners. ping @leo @sara for SDK bits.
Frank: thanks. can you drop the tracking PR link?
Anya: sure — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pulls/412
Leo: I can take the JS SDK snippets (examples/client-js/*). plan: replace outdated snippets, add short inline notes about idiomatic usage. question: for config keys, should examples match SDK surface or the REST API style?
Anya: prefer language-idiomatic examples: JS -> camelCase, Python -> snake_case. If it's an HTTP example, use REST param names. Add a 1-line header: "Snippet shows idiomatic usage for <language>".
Sara: found two broken links in embeddings guide: /docs/embeddings#limits and /api/old-route — I'll open a redirect PR. also saw a mismatched heading level that breaks the TOC.
Tom: I'll review that redirect PR. also: propose we standardize on the term 'model variant' when referring to quantized/finetuned variants; keep 'model' for the base model name.
Frank: agreed. small glossary update required. do we have a glossary entry template?
Anya: yes: docs/glossary/templates/term.md — example in the repo is model-variant.md. Use that format and include 'also known as' aliases so searches pick it up.
docs-bot: docs-lint — 12 warnings: 7 broken links, 3 voice/style mismatches, 2 code-block format issues. Full report: https://ci.redwood.ai/docs-lint/412
Leo: quick follow-up: for SDK param names shown in code snippets — when the snippet demonstrates calling the hosted API via SDK, match SDK naming (camelCase in JS). When the snippet shows raw HTTP curl, use REST names. we'll add that to the style guide.
Sara: PRs I'll open: 412-fix-links, 413-embeddings-examples, 414-glossary-model-variant. Reviewers: @tom @frank @anya.
Tom: ack, I'll do 413 review by EOD.
Anya: thanks — also want a short voice rule: concise, active voice; prefer present tense; avoid 'we' when describing platform internals. I'll add a 4-line blurb under docs/style/voice.md and ping for quick +1.
Frank: +1
Leo: +1
Sara: added a checklist item to PR templates: 'language-idiomatic examples' and 'glossary crosslinks' so reviewers can tick it off.
Anya: great. if anyone hits build/snippet blockers ping #devex for snippet-bench infra. Final plan: merge small fixes this week, schedule a glossary review for next Tue, and rotate follow-ups into the weekly docs sync.
Tom: noted.
